75355: Clear [Special Portal 1](#loc=75303) in Country of the Muskateers as Riku.
75365:
The hardest part of this fight is Holey Moley constantly teleporting away from Riku. This makes close-range attacks and Keyblade combos almost impossible, so it's better to come prepared with ranged commands to close the distance between Riku and Holey Moley. 

During some of its teleports, Holey Moley will be replaced by a bunch of hands; defeat them all to make Holey Moley reappear in the fighting area.
